verdict: Meta going dark has stopped lead flow; Google spend needs immediate accountability.
narrative: This period, all 128 leads came from Meta, which went dark on August 14th — since then, new lead volume has dropped to zero from that channel. At the same time, Google Ads spent $1,495 over the 28 days and recorded no verified conversions, meaning that budget is currently running without measurable return. Meta is being brought back online, and conversion tracking on Google is being repaired so spend can be tied directly to results. A full stack re-test and offline conversion import are both targeted for completion by August 31st, which should give a clearer picture of true performance heading into next period.
